name: @pipeworx/mcp-sf-recpark

tools.description: Upcoming San Francisco Rec & Park events & programming (parks, plazas, rec centers). Filter by date window and keyword (title/location/description). Free/outdoor/community civic events.

query.description: Keyword over title, location, and description, e.g. "yoga", "Golden Gate", "kids".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sf-recpark forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sf-recpark pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
